Partner over client accounting and advisory: the monthly closes, bookkeeping, payroll, and anything a client calls 'a quick question'. Owns pricing for new recurring work.

From: Alice Kwon
To: Colin Mackey
Subject: Following up on associate buy-in

Hi Colin,

I wanted to follow up on the associate buy-in question we touched on last week. I apologize for the delay in getting back to you—I've been buried in the books, and I appreciate your patience as we sort through everything.

Could we set up a brief call to discuss the next steps? I'd like to get your perspective on how to approach this with the associate, especially given the current financials. I've also looped in Elias for any accounting details we might need.

Let me know what works for you. Thanks again for your understanding.

Best,
Alice

I really appreciate you checking with Elias on the accounting side as well. I’ll make sure he’s looped in for the call so we can cover any details that come up.

Again, sorry for the delay on my end—the books have been a bit of a tangle, but I’m grateful for your patience.

Best,
Alice
